probe_finding: Definition (authors @GridironGrading, deep-scroll catalog, read 2026-10-15): IMPACT SCORE — a rookie's impact measured as the percentage of his plays that show up in the box score (tackles, pressures, catches, stops — the events a box score records); the authors state it feeds their final draft grades alongside the C-318 overall prospect score. Stamped instances (published leaders): Xavier Watts 94.4, Jihaad Campbell 92.2 — the top of the published scale. Role in-engine: a post-draft validation instrument — it grades the graders (C-318's pre-draft scores against realized rookie involvement), which is the draft-lane form of the engine's grade-everything discipline.
